entities.name: Maelstrom Wanderer
entities.description: 60-foot-tall walking storm of quasi-living magic, an elemental of Alara spawned by the Maelstrom.

entities.name: Maelstrom
entities.description: Point where the five shards of Alara merged; a whirlpool of mana, aether and magic, mostly gone now.

events.summary: The five shards of Alara merged at the Maelstrom.
events.quote: The Maelstrom was the point at which the five shards of the plane of Alara merged
